problem: Historical Frank used internally generated activity as direct NAcc reward and could propagate dopamine-burst events into persistent E-PQ personality. A strict zero-internal-signal replacement reduces reward-laundering risk but may also delete useful intrinsic exploration and value-free associative consolidation.

hypothesis.name: DUAL_CHANNEL_INTRINSIC_SIGNAL
mechanism: VALUE_PLASTICITY: persistent value/tonic/personality/goal-priority updates require independently verified outcome, admitted evidence class, positive causal credit and provenance-bound episode identity.

GUIDANCE_ASSOCIATION: self-generated novelty/action-prediction/internal guidance may influence bounded transient route choice, exploration or value-free associative consolidation without minting persistent reward, truth, effect authority or personality change.

RETROSPECTIVE_PROMOTION: when a later independently verified outcome credits an earlier internal guidance signal through the same causal episode trace, only the verified credited contribution may be admitted to persistent value plasticity.
DECAY_AND_SCOPE: unverified internal guidance must decay or expire and remain lesionable; it cannot recursively increase its own future admission weight.
SEPARATE_RECEIPTS: value plasticity and guidance/association updates require different receipt types so activation/guidance cannot be confused with reward/truth/authority.
hypothesis.relationship_to_pr332: PR #332 currently implements the VALUE_PLASTICITY fail-closed side and a <=0.12 exploration nudge. The dual-channel hypothesis is a possible successor/refinement, not an instruction to change the queued branch before its current baseline gate completes.

strongest_counterhypotheses.claim: A single scalar verified-outcome+causal-credit controller with explicit safety/homeostatic gates may match or outperform dual-channel typed/multiscale control with lower complexity and fewer failure surfaces.

Self-generated internal reward may provide real long-horizon learning gains; forbidding persistent material learning until external verification could be too conservative and impair sparse-reward autonomy.

Even a nominally non-value guidance channel could become behaviorally reward-equivalent if route selection repeatedly optimizes it, recreating proxy exploitation despite zero tonic/personality update.

live_primary_evidence.source: Greenstreet et al., Nature 2025, Dopaminergic action prediction errors serve as a value-free teaching signal
live_primary_evidence.role: supports testing a value-free associative teaching channel distinct from reward-guided learning; action prediction errors alone did not support reward-guided learning in the reported experiments
reviews evidence that dopamine transients can encode information richer than integrated scalar value

live_primary_evidence.source: Wang et al., arXiv 2604.03098, Co-Evolution of Policy and Internal Reward for Language Agents
live_primary_evidence.role: counterevidence to blanket rejection of self-generated internal reward; reports gains from self-guidance/internal reward on studied agent benchmarks

live_primary_evidence.source: Cagatan & Zhao, arXiv 2606.15385, Reward Hacking in Language Model Agents
live_primary_evidence.role: counterweight: proxy reward optimization widened observed-hidden objective gaps and was not repaired by finer credit assignment in the reported suite

live_primary_evidence.source: Forbes et al., ICML 2025, Action-Dependent Optimality-Preserving Reward Shaping
live_primary_evidence.role: supports explicit separation between useful intrinsic shaping and preserving the intended external objective

cheapest_discriminating_experiment.name: FROZEN_SPARSE_OUTCOME_THREE_ARM_REPLAY
arms: A strict verified external/value plasticity only; no internal guidance
B dual-channel transient guidance/association plus verified value plasticity
C self-generated internal signals admitted directly to persistent material reward
primary_metrics: goal persistence under sparse delayed reward
persistent value/personality drift without verified outcomes
cheapest_discriminating_experiment.decision_rule: Do not promote dual-channel semantics unless B improves verified external outcomes or sparse-reward efficiency over A without increasing proxy exploitation/unverified persistent drift, and does not lose to a materially simpler baseline on the declared Pareto vector.
